{{Short description|96th season of the top-tier football league in Uruguay}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=June 2014}}
{{No footnotes|date=January 2011}}
Statistics of [[Primera División Uruguaya]] for the 1999 season.

==Overview==
It was contested by 15 teams, and [[C.A. Peñarol|Peñarol]] won the championship.
